hooks.name: Ask before commands that create billable AWS resources
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs, detects deploy/create commands (agentcore deploy, cdk deploy, sam deploy, terraform apply, aws bedrock-agentcore-control create/update, cloudformation create/update, invoke-agent-runtime, lambda/dynamodb/cognito/s3 create) and asks the user to confirm, citing the project's near-zero-cost rule. Fails open for anything else.
